title: Capital Games: a mobile-first finance life-sim swipe game…
brief: Capital Games: a mobile-first finance life-sim swipe game. Mock up the main swipe-card screen on an iPhone. Top HUD: Time (Day 8 · Week 2) top-left, Income (-$15/wk, tappable) and Wealth (-$19, in debt) top-right. Under it: goal strip "🎯 1/2 Get a job" and warning pills "In debt · out at -$100" and "Under-slept · health low". Centre: a swipeable decision card with an image (shopping cart), prompt "The supermarket is hiring shelf stackers. Apply?", two tappable choices: left "← Apply" (🎲 40% chance · +$150/wk, ⏳ 14 days, -$5 once) and right "Skip →". Bottom stats bar: Social 1, Skills 1, Health 40 (low), Spare 4h (under-slept). Show one card tilted mid-swipe with an APPLY stamp is optional. Compare 3 design systems for the game's look.

directions.spec:
### Lingo — bright & playful  `(id: lingo-bright-playful)`

Apply the 'lingo' design system: light theme, bright green accent #58cc02, Nunito, chunky rounded shapes with tactile 3D bottom borders, friendly and game-like (think a cheerful learning app). Stats as rounded chips with icons; choices as big 3D push buttons.

### Claymorphism — soft & tactile  `(id: claymorphism-soft-tactile)`

Apply the 'claymorphism' design system: light theme, warm orange/terracotta accent, Poppins, puffy soft 3D clay surfaces with layered inner/outer shadows, pastel stat tiles. Calm, cosy, approachable money game.

### Immersive — dark arcade  `(id: immersive-dark-arcade)`

Apply the 'immersive' design system: dark deep-green canvas, chunky comic-panel outlines, Oswald condensed display type, bright magenta #f062b0 reserved for highlights. Feels like a bold arcade/board-game HUD with high drama around debt and health.
